faq_heading: New construction in South Cambie, Vancouver: your questions answered

faq.q: What have condos in South Cambie, Vancouver sold for?

items.t: 14 townhomes sold in South Cambie, Vancouver at a median of $1,592,500 (middle half $1,426,250 to $1,831,500). A typical townhome in South Cambie, Vancouver spent 16 days on the market and closed at 96.3% of the asking price.
In South Cambie, Vancouver, condos sold at a median of $815,000 across 29 sales, and the middle half closed between $700,000 and $1,175,000. The median condo sat 35 days and sold for 97.5% of list.

blocks.text: Source: Paragon closed sales, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026; medians need 5 or more sales.
How South Cambie compares with the rest of Vancouver West

items.t: Of 18 Vancouver West sub-areas with 5 or more townhome sales, South Cambie ranks 6th highest at $1,592,500; the range is $850,000 (False Creek) to $2,255,000 (Coal Harbour). Oakridge ($1,540,000) sits just below and Point Grey ($1,675,000) sits just above.

Condos in South Cambie have the 13th highest median of 21 Vancouver West sub-areas, $815,000. Marpole is lowest at $613,500 and Coal Harbour highest at $1,228,000. Kitsilano ($782,500) sits just below and Mount Pleasant VW ($837,500) sits just above.

blocks.text: By build year, condos are the newest homes selling in South Cambie, Vancouver (median 2021) and townhomes the oldest (median 2004), a gap of 17 years.
